tools.title: Vox
tools.pitch: Offline dictation — hold a key, talk, and cleaned-up text lands in whatever window has focus.
tools.audience: For writers and devs who talk faster than they type and won't install cloud dictation.

tools.title: pomodoro-timer
tools.pitch: A desktop pomodoro timer that stays out of the way — tray-native, no account, no sync.
tools.audience: For desk workers who want a timer, not a productivity platform.

tools.title: claude-dispatch
tools.pitch: A dispatch hub for Claude Code sessions — queue work, launch sessions, watch tokens and cost.
tools.audience: For Claude Code users running more sessions than they can hold in their head.

tools.title: Senses
tools.pitch: Modular AR audio-visual instruments for Android — camera, motion, and generative audio composed into playable artifacts.
tools.audience: For performers and visual artists who want the room itself to become the instrument.
